name: TeamStarWolf - The Dot-Com Era: Cyber Events, 1994 to 2003
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified record of the dot-com era, 1994 to 2003, supports: CERT/CC advisories and incident notes (IN-99-03, CA-1999-04, CA-1999-17, CA-2000-01, CA-2000-04, CA-2001-19, CA-2001-23, CA-2001-26, CA-2003-04, CA-2003-08, CA-2003-20), the Microsoft bulletins MS01-033, MS02-039 and MS03-026, DOJ records, cDc's own Back Orifice pages, F-Secure's Klez description and Kaspersky's Moonlight Maze findings. The events predate ATT&CK, so every mapping is the study's retrospective reading. Revoked ids map through data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/DOTCOM_ERA_CYBER_EVENTS.md. Scores rank the record behind each technique, not severity: 100 a Confirmed primary record describes the behavior, 60 the behavior is known only from a Reported source (the Solar Sunrise profile), 40 the id choice itself stretches the record (Mitnick's Valid Accounts).

legendItems.label: 40: id choice stretches the record (Mitnick's Valid Accounts)
60: behavior known only from a Reported source (Solar Sunrise profile)
100: a Confirmed primary record describes the behavior
